sheet:
Create an original production fighting-game sprite sheet of AMANDA KONRAD, faithfully based on the LAST THREE attached reference images: poster for art direction, real portraits for face, body and outfit. Adult mature professional woman, fair skin, recognizable rounded face and smile, copper-red wavy hair tied back in consistent ponytail with a few loose curls, off-white ruffled blouse long sleeves, blue jeans, lanyard badge, low white sneakers. Natural real-world proportions, NOT thin superhero body. Detailed 1990s arcade pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, shaded fabric and readable limbs. No microphone, logos, text or scenery. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background.
Exactly 40 isolated full-body poses in uniform 8 columns x 5 rows, row-major. Target 1536x1120, each cell192x224. Every character faces RIGHT. Identical character size, face, clothes and hair. At least 8px transparent margins per cell. All feet anchored at same bottom baseline except airborne. No overlap between cells. No grid lines/numbers/labels.
Row1 frames0-7: four subtle idle guarded stance poses, then four progressive walk steps.
Row2 frames8-15: walk step5, walk step6, jump rise knees lifting, jump apex knees tucked, jump falling legs down, low crouch, standing punch startup fist drawn back, standing punch ACTIVE arm extended horizontally right.
Row3 frames16-23: punch recovery arm retracting, kick startup knee lifted, kick ACTIVE leg extended horizontally right at waist height, kick recovery leg retracting, crouching punch startup, crouching punch ACTIVE arm extended right, crouching punch recovery, low kick startup crouching.
Row4 frames24-31: low kick ACTIVE foot extended near ground right, low kick recovery crouched, airborne punch startup fist back knees bent, airborne punch ACTIVE arm extended right, airborne punch recovery, airborne kick startup knee raised, airborne kick ACTIVE foot extended right, airborne kick recovery.
Row5 frames32-39: standing high block forearms protecting face, crouched block low guard, hurt1 recoiling backward, hurt2 stronger recoil, knockout start losing balance, knockout falling sideways, knockout lying flat on ground head left feet right, victory smiling one open hand raised presenting confidently.
Never substitute a neutral pose for ACTIVE punches/kicks. Complete bodies including all shoes within each cell. Not chibi, no exaggerated anatomy. Consistent proportions across all 40 poses.
